reported_recurrence.source: User report from the official Mac local task

diagnosis.confirmed_code_defect: Every CallTool error poisoned the adapter, including cancelled or timed-out read-only queries. An already-cancelled context could also be dispatched before permanently blocking subsequent reads.
diagnosis.limitation: The old running instance discarded the underlying error; the reproducible cancellation defect is not proof that cancellation caused this particular recurrence.

changes: Reject already-cancelled requests before calling the driver
Allow a later NEW read after a cancelled or deadline-exceeded list_apps, list_windows or get_window_state request; never retry the interrupted request automatically
Keep unknown transport failures and uncertain mutations blocked until connection reconstruction
Expose content-free driver_status metadata through authenticated local status: last operation, error category, optional JSON-RPC code and time
Make driver_connected reflect the adapter's last known call/connection state rather than pointer existence; keep status responsive during an in-flight call
Retain the original latched error category across subsequent blocked calls, without recording arguments, response contents or arbitrary native error strings

tests.controlled_real_mcp_sdk_cancellation_ses: passed; in-memory MCP server, cancelled read followed by two successful discovery calls, no automatic retry

deployment.source: Current Windows session, not official Mac-origin acceptance
deployment.initial_observe_while_paused: refused with paused; resumed locally before further read-only verification

remaining: Official Mac task must rediscover and observe Windows before deciding whether the pending 4x9 calculation can proceed
Keep original clear-all unknown; do not resend it or reuse prior coordinates, tokens or screenshots
If driver_unavailable recurs, inspect the new local driver_status before restarting so the failure category is preserved
Verify actual 36 result, action receipts and final screenshot delivery from the official Mac-origin task
privacy: No credentials, private app lists, image bytes, entered text, device identifiers or nonce stored
